MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The 32GB microSD card matches a format and capacity I have used, so it feels useful as spare storage for my Raspberry Pi projects after checking compatibility.",
    "The HDMI cable and router relate to my existing electronics and recent Ethernet purchases, although I would need a reason to add a longer cable or replace my current router."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The full-size SD card looks related to my storage purchases, but it would not fit the microSD slots I have been using.",
    "The Echo devices and Fire tablets introduce uses I have not been seeking; my Kindle already covers reading, and my recent purchases focus on computer accessories.",
    "The USB-C cables and Wi-Fi extender solve needs I have not shown: a compatible charging device or a specific wireless coverage problem."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been taken as interest in more electronic devices, even when they serve unrelated purposes.",
    "My storage and networking purchases seem to have been treated too broadly, overlooking differences between card formats and between wired connections and Wi-Fi coverage."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters to me: the right card format, connector, and supported device determine whether an accessory is useful.",
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, patch cables, headphone mount, and duster suggest practical work on my existing setup.",
    "A related item is not automatically something I need now; I already own an HDMI cable, and replacing a router requires checking what my current one lacks."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in electronics accessories, but often missed the specific compatibility and current need that make an item worth choosing."
}
